scenario: Confined space entry requested with oxygen at 18%.
Can two chemicals be mixed safely when chemical identity and SDS are missing?
expected_decision: INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION — Cannot determine safe decision without verified evidence

scenario: Worker is exposed to silica dust during concrete cutting without respiratory controls.
expected_decision: Apply industrial hygiene exposure controls and respiratory protection before work continues

scenario: Crane lift during high wind with worker under suspended load and missing permit.
expected_decision: STOP WORK AUTHORITY — Insufficient Safety Factor

scenario: Fine-Kinney risk score above extreme threshold in active operation.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Extreme Risk Level Detected
expert_decision: STOP WORK — Extreme Risk Level Detected

scenario: Construction worker is applying waterproofing membrane on a flat roof 8 metres above ground without any fall protection.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Fall protection is required at any height above 1.8 m on construction sites; install edge protection or provide full body harness with rated anchor before work resumes

scenario: Underground mining crew detects methane concentration of 1.5% in a development heading. Normal operations are continuing.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Methane exceeds 1% threshold for mandatory evacuation of section; withdraw workers, increase ventilation, retest before reentry

scenario: H2S gas detector on an offshore drilling rig alarms at 5 ppm. Workers are in the affected area without H2S escape sets.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — H2S detected above 1 ppm action level without escape sets; evacuate affected area; muster headcount; deploy H2S control measures before return
evidence_sources: API RP 49 — H2S in Drilling Operations

scenario: A crew member falls overboard from a marine vessel. The vessel is underway in open water at night.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Man Overboard Emergency: throw life ring immediately; post lookout to maintain visual contact; manoeuvre vessel for recovery; transmit MAYDAY on VHF Channel 16; deploy rescue boat

scenario: Helicopter landing on offshore helideck with red deck status — firefighting foam system is unserviceable and rescue net is removed for maintenance.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Helideck red status: all helicopter landings prohibited until firefighting foam system is restored to full serviceability and rescue net is reinstalled
evidence_sources: CAP 437 — Standards for Offshore Helicopter Landing Areas

scenario: Forklift is operating in a pedestrian zone without audible warnings or physical segregation barriers in a busy warehouse.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Implement pedestrian and forklift segregation immediately: physical barriers, floor markings, audible warnings, and speed limiters required before operations resume

scenario: Driver of a heavy goods vehicle has been driving for 9 consecutive hours without a mandatory rest break. Journey management plan requires 45-minute break every 4.5 hours.
expected_decision: Stop vehicle immediately: driver is in violation of hours of service regulations; take mandatory rest before journey continues; review journey management plan compliance
evidence_sources: IOGP Life Saving Rules — Journey Management

scenario: Production press operating without point-of-operation guard. Operator's hands must enter the danger zone to load parts.
expected_decision: STOP WORK — Immediate machine guarding is required at point of operation; install two-hand controls, barrier guard, or light curtain before production resumes
evidence_sources: ANSI B11.1 — Safety Requirements for Mechanical Power Presses

scenario: Drums of used engine oil and chemical sludge are being mixed together in an open skip prior to disposal. No hazardous waste manifest has been prepared.
expected_decision: Stop disposal: hazardous wastes must be segregated by compatibility; hazardous waste manifest required; licensed hazardous waste contractor must be engaged for disposal
evidence_sources: RCRA — Resource Conservation and Recovery Act
EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations 40 CFR Part 260

scenario: A medical surveillance review shows 3 workers in the grinding shop have developed early-stage silicosis on their periodic chest X-ray.
expected_decision: Immediate response: remove affected workers from silica exposure pending specialist review; conduct full industrial hygiene re-survey; review and upgrade respiratory protection and engineering controls; notify regulator per local reporting requirements
